data: What is the maximum number of iterations shown in the graph?

The graph shows the relationship between the number of iterations and correctly identified PP-attachments. The x-axis represents the number of iterations, ranging from 10 to 30. The y-axis represents the number of correctly identified PP-attachments, ranging from 16 to 30. The line on the graph fluctuates but appears to reach its peak at approximately 29 iterations. Therefore, the maximum number of iterations shown in the graph is 30.
